palette_rationale: Preserve the approved pale fur, source eye contrast, dark claws, and pink-red mouth within the reviewed Idle palette.
reference: Own DSTS chr569 model and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names, timing fields and event fields.
ground_policy_note: Fixed row-47 grounded shadow; retain native crouch, recoil and Hop lift rather than normalizing the lowest opaque appendage.

actions.pose_evidence: Native quadrupedal forepaw and hindleg gait; omit duplicate loop endpoint.

actions.name: Attack

actions.pose_evidence: Source open-mouth special release; no invented projectile.

actions.name: Swing

actions.name: Hop
